headline: Apple partners with Alibaba to train custom AI model for China
summary: The tech giant is reportedly developing a China-specific large language model with Alibaba to comply with local regulations and offer generative AI services.
details: Apple has reportedly partnered with Chinese tech giant Alibaba to train a custom AI model specifically for the China market. This move is a departure from Apple's usual strategy and aims to give the company more control over its products in the competitive Chinese smartphone sector.

Historically, Apple has utilized domestic Chinese AI models for generative AI features on devices sold in China, as U.S.-based models like OpenAI's ChatGPT are not available there. This new partnership could allow Apple to offer its own proprietary AI model.

The development comes as Apple prepares to launch its on-device generative AI service, Apple Intelligence, in China. Sources indicate this will happen "in the coming months after an update to its iOS operating system."

Apple officially registered its generative AI service with China's cyberspace regulator last month, a crucial step for device rollout. This collaboration with Alibaba could help Apple navigate Beijing's stringent regulatory landscape for AI.
If approved, Apple would be the first U.S. company to offer a proprietary AI model in China, according to Reuters. The company has not yet responded to requests for comment.
